notes.title: Release Date Locked – You Suck At Football kicks off the 4th of AUGUST 2025!
notes.notes:
Launching on 4th AUGUST 2025!


Hey everyone, I’m thrilled to confirm that You Suck At Football releases on Steam this 4th of AUGUST 2025.


What to expect
• Singleplayer and mutliplayer physics chaos inspired by *Only Up* & *Chained Together*

• Brutal parkour courses where one wrong kick resets your progress (there are checkpoints too)

• Perfect for voice‑chat meltdowns and victory dances alike 🕺


Wishlist & share
Smash that green button and tag your friends—every wishlist boosts visibility. P.S. I’m currently integrating your awesome play‑test feedback so launch day is as smooth (and punishing) as possible. See you on the pitch! ⚽️🔥



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842740/You_Suck_At_Football/"][/dynamiclink]
